item_short_desc: Experience enhanced warmth in harsh weather with Rothco's G.I. Type Poncho Liner, affectionately known as The Woobie. This versatile field-proven poncho liner, measuring 62 inch x 82 inch, offers additional insulation. Beyond its role as a poncho accessory, it transforms into a cozy sleeping bag or blanket, ideal for camping adventures. Crafted from durable 100% rip-stop polyester, it ensures both longevity and comfort. The corner tie strings enable easy attachment to your poncho, providing a secure fit.
